summary: Woodside Energy Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching its Second Quarter 2026 Report. The report details operational and financial performance, including production volumes of 41.3 MMboe and operating revenue of $4,185 million. It provides project updates on Scarborough, Trion, and Louisiana LNG, and notes the exercise of pre-emption rights to acquire a 10.67% interest in the Browse Joint Venture. No pricing terms, premium, or timetables for that acquisition are provided. The filing is a routine quarterly operational update with no special-situation transaction announced.
